scope_notes: Source/metadata inspection and selected primary-document verification only; no corpus execution, builds, model benchmark or scanner-profile tuning.
Each case is independently submitted by the benchmark. A safe sibling is not an automatic expected fix. Cross-pair API differences are annotated as migration concerns, not false safe labels.
Local verdicts do not establish case independence or human approval. The corpus-wide release blockers apply to every case.
